title: Show the source
summary: Opens the source page behind what this persona just explained, in AI Web over the chat. Only an address the pack's own notes carry is ever opened.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks where something comes from, or for the source. Pass the money word or idea they mean; leave it empty for what was just explained.

arguments.name: about
arguments.description: The word or idea they want the source for; empty for what was just explained

example: Show me where that comes from

privateChat.keeps: Nothing from the chat. The page's site sees a visit, and AI Web keeps no history of it.

_note: Phase FL.10 (2026-11-16): a step for a companion pack (agent.mode "companion"), which chats as a persona and takes a step only when the person asks. It carries no route words: the pack's own `agent.ask` phrases offer it, so the general Agent's router never does.
